name: Cra Normal Window Fixture
description: Made up for scripts/scenario.sh: on a page opened with ?n=normal-window it makes a normal window on about:blank and uses its id (windows.get, windows.getAll, tabs.create and tabs.query in it, windows.remove), as an agent extension's own window does (GitHub #578), and a normal window on a page, which becomes a Cra tab. It reports by asking the fixture server for page.html?n=normal-window-<answers>.
